name: Soccermania

features.name: Penalty shootout bonus
features.description: Up to five kicks, each possibly adding a multiplier to the cup.

features.name: Cup multiplier
features.description: The total collected is applied to your bet.

review:
A five-line game with a penalty shootout for a bonus. You take up to five kicks at goal, and each corner holds a multiplier.

Hit a corner and its value goes into the cup; miss the goal and it's over. At the end, the cup's total is applied to your bet, up to 999x. It's one of the most interactive bonuses we list, even though the result is random. Very high volatility, 1,059x max and 96.23% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
